meta.parties: Hebtulabhoy, M.S. & Co. Ltd. v. Stassen Exports Ltd. and Another

rules.statement: The use of 'Chai el Rabea' by the respondent in Arabic is likely to mislead the public and infringe the appellant's registered trade mark 'Rabea'.
rules.supporting_quote: "In deciding whether "Rabea" in Roman characters and "Chai el Rabea" in Arabic are deceptively similar, it must be held that they are."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 117(2Ha) of the Code of Intellectual Property Act No: 52 of 1979
